about_page.title: Software engineer in Lomé, from business need to production.
about_page.lead: I'm Kalvin Takoudjou. I design and build complete solutions — web platforms, mobile apps and SaaS systems — from requirements to production: REST APIs, backend architectures, cross-platform apps, payments, multi-tenancy and offline-first.

business.title: Start from the business
business.text: Employee time tracking, ticket sales, inventory, rentals: every project starts from the real process it has to serve, before any choice of tools.

system.title: One system, several screens
system.text: A mobile app in the field, a dashboard on the web, an API at the centre: the same data serves every screen.

delivery.title: Ship, not just build
delivery.text: Docker, reverse proxy, backup and restore, service monitoring: software is finished when it runs, and stays operable, for the people who use it.

architecture.title: Make the architecture readable
architecture.text: Every project in this portfolio comes with its diagram — components, exchanges, stack — so that a client and a developer alike can see what was built.

footer.description: Full-stack and mobile software engineer. Web and mobile applications shipped to production, from Lomé.

experience.job1_description: Design, development and delivery of custom web and mobile solutions, from requirements and specifications to deployment, maintenance and evolution.
experience.job2_description: IT asset management, equipment maintenance and user support, keeping the work tools operational.
experience.edu1_title: MBA in Big Data and Artificial Intelligence
experience.edu1_description: Specialisation in large-scale data architectures, machine learning and the integration of AI into business processes.
experience.edu2_title: Bachelor's degree in Computer Systems and Software
experience.edu2_description: Design and development of websites and mobile applications, with databases and management tools.
job1_points: Analysis of client needs and specifications, turned into functional and technical solutions.
Design of application architectures, data models, REST APIs and business flows suited to each project.
Development and integration of backends, APIs, web interfaces, mobile apps and third-party services.
Engineering practices: code quality and modularity, security, data validation, error handling.
Testing, debugging, optimisation and stabilisation before release.
Deployment, corrective and evolutive maintenance, continuous improvement from client feedback.
Technology watch to improve application performance, reliability and scalability.
job2_points: Management and tracking of IT assets: computers, peripherals and equipment.
Preventive and corrective maintenance of workstations and peripherals.
Diagnosis and resolution of hardware and software incidents.
Installation, configuration and updates of workstations, software and equipment.
Technical support and guidance for users.
Tracking of maintenance, replacement and renewal needs.

testimonials.t1_quote: Kalvin is a rigorous and creative professional. He came up with considerate and innovative solutions.
testimonials.t2_quote: He has a clear vision of what he wants and knows how to get there.
testimonials.t3_quote: A very good team member who brings good spirits and seriousness to the team while contributing significantly to the success of our projects.

atelier.short: Full-stack e-commerce platform for selling and delivering organic products, with an internal wallet and Mobile Money and card payments.
atelier.full: REST API, admin back office, customer area, internal wallet, multi-channel payments, background jobs and production-grade Docker infrastructure.
points: Django / Django REST Framework backend: REST API covering users, catalogue, orders, payments, transactions and wallet.
Next.js / TypeScript frontend: catalogue, cart, orders, customer account and order tracking.
Admin back office: users, products, categories, orders, stock, payments and transactions.
Customer area: profile, addresses, orders, payments, wallet and transaction history.
Mobile Money payments with PayDunya and card payments with Stripe, with webhooks and secure synchronisation of payment and order statuses.
Full order lifecycle: creation, payment, processing and delivery.
Roles and access rights separating administration from customers; soft delete, audit trail and timestamps on business data.
Background and scheduled jobs with Celery and Redis.
Production on Docker and Linux: PostgreSQL, Django, Next.js, Redis, Celery and a Traefik reverse proxy, with media management.
Database and media backup and restore; groundwork for monitoring and administration of the Docker services.

shemm.short: Android and iOS platform for event management and digital ticketing: discovery, ticket purchase, Mobile Money payment and entry control.
shemm.full: Flutter app for attendees, back office for organisers, Django REST API, secure digital tickets, validation scanner and sales and attendance statistics.
points: Android and iOS app in Flutter / Dart: event discovery, booking and ticket management.
Django / Django REST Framework backend and REST APIs dedicated to the mobile app.
Complete ticketing: ticket categories, prices, quotas, availability, orders, attendees and ticket issuing.
Mobile Money payments with PayDunya and tracking of the transaction lifecycle.
Back office to create, configure and manage events and their ticketing.
Secure digital tickets, from purchase to use: creation, payment, issuing, validation.
Scanner optimised for fast validation at busy entrances, detecting invalid or already-used tickets.
Real-time entry tracking; dashboards for sales, revenue, tickets issued and used, availability and fill rate.
API separating users, events, ticketing, payments, validation and statistics; access control and transaction audit trail.

challenger.short: Windows software for calculating employee working hours.
challenger.full: Windows timekeeping and employee working hours calculation software.

mboashop.short: Full e-commerce platform with dynamic cart, integrated payment and admin dashboard.
mboashop.full: Full-stack e-commerce platform with rich catalog, dynamic cart, multi-channel payment and analytics dashboard.

myriade.short: Premium corporate showcase site for a multi-sector B2B & B2C services group.
myriade.full: Modern institutional platform with SSG architecture, cinematic animations, and SEO optimization.

stock.short: Real-time stock management with automatic alerts and advanced reporting.
stock.full: Inventory management SaaS with real-time tracking, restocking alerts and barcodes.

green.short: Multi-tenant web and mobile SaaS for managing farms, teams and field operations, with an offline-first mobile app.
green.full: Each company gets an isolated workspace. Technicians carry out their operations on mobile, even without a network, and synchronise them with the platform as soon as the connection is back.
points: Multi-tenant SaaS architecture: data isolation and independent management of several companies.
Management of companies, farms, plots, teams and users, with roles for managers, agronomists, technicians and workers.
Farming operations workflow: creation, planning, assignment, execution, tracking and closing.
Flutter / Dart mobile app for technicians, built offline-first with an Isar local database.
Device-to-cloud synchronisation limited to the data needed, so it stays smooth on low-bandwidth connections.
Consistency between local and remote state despite intermittent connectivity.
Django / Django REST Framework backend and REST APIs used by the Next.js / TypeScript web platform and the mobile app.
Platform subscriptions and payments with Stripe.
Audit trail of business operations; architecture designed for scalability, resilience and data separation between tenants.

locamanager.short: Android and iOS mobile app for managing rental properties end to end.
locamanager.full: Android and iOS mobile app for managing rental properties, with a data pipeline, RESTful API and interactive visualizations.

lotus.short: Multi-tenant platform for end-to-end store and shop management.
lotus.full: Multi-tenant platform for in-store promotion management, with a data pipeline, RESTful API and interactive visualizations.
